steps.assistant_text: Retrospective verified source port onto frozen upstream. Independent native C, original USO identities, both raw modes, full ROM, six strict code-block payloads and no exact/raw/partial regression pass. Canonical and remote branches untouched.

analysis.purpose: Builds texture-load and texture-rectangle commands for a horizontal span, using 32-wide strips followed by the remainder. Texture format and valid input bounds remain uncertain.
analysis.observed_abi: Five O32 word arguments: object pointer in a0, destination x/y in a1/a2, source x in a3, and span width at incoming sp+0x10. Metadata dimensions use signed halfword loads; divisions are signed. Original return types remain unknown; ignored results do not establish void.

Seven words: context, destination x/y, remaining, height, horizontal quotient, vertical quotient. Quotients use (dimension<<10)/dimension. Result ignored.

evidence: Original TextReloc records resolve 0x2CEC/0x2D4C through Sym 11, Text+0x4350, and 0x2D0C/0x2DA0 through Sym 12, Text+0x4564. Accounting for the leading four-byte flag identifies curated functions 00004354/00004568.

Inspected both callees and shared layout family 000027A0, 00002BB0, 00002DE0, 0000329C and 00003714. Reused GuiTextureObject/GuiTextureInfo: object +0x10; metadata image word +0x08, signed dimensions +0x20/+0x22, mode +0x24.
Reused GfxRing_413C: context +0x0C points to buffer at +0 and index at +4. The initial packet contains 0xBB000001 and 0x80008000.
Staged signed height promotion restores s0/s1/s2 allocation and width at sp+0x58. A post-loop source-coordinate lifetime marker restores coordinate-copy order.

Both compiled C bodies equal the immutable expected function: 560 bytes, SHA256 fafa07bc0bfa0cdfcfd823ca2185538b92965f7fc59506ab6adda7135168c8b2. Objdiff's residual 99.84286% score reflects relocation annotations; raw instruction differences are zero.

ROM is byte-identical to baserom; all six compressed blocks pass. Four previously exact unit functions remain byte-exact in both modes. Other function bodies and existing aliases are unchanged this attempt.
Assigned function exports Sym 46, original Text+0x2BAC. No local caller relocation was recovered; external/indirect callers and game.uso DFS reachability remain unverified.

Fresh upstream port: original compiler in both modes, complete native call/data USO identity checks, exact source-generated tables/constants, exact host function bytes, full ROM and all six strict original code-block payloads.
